title: Themes and shuffle
summary: Three themes, questions shuffled each game, and a record per theme.
done: You saw a real algorithm: the Fisher-Yates shuffle.

hello.text: In level 4, you pick a theme, the questions are shuffled, and each theme has its record.

load.text: The theme is a number. Theme 1 is loaded first; [if] the theme is 2 or 3, its lists replace it.

fill.text: To shuffle, we don’t move the questions: we make an **order** list: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5…

mix.text: … then, from the last place to the 2nd, we swap each place with a random place before it. It is the **Fisher-Yates** algorithm: every order has the same chance.

pick.text: Question number index is the one in the shuffled order.

record.text: The **records** list is *stored*: the phone keeps a record per theme.

slow.text: Start **slow motion** to see the blocks light up.

watch.text: Watch the swaps light up: 4 swaps for 5 questions.
watch.hint: Tap an answer in the preview, or click “Restart”.

space.text: Add a question to the space theme.

three.text: Games of 3 questions: stop after the 3rd.
three.hint: In “go to the next question”, compare the index with 3 instead of the length of the list.

cheer.text: Show “New record!” when there is one.
cheer.hint: A short message in the record [if].
